notes: Players may wish to grab a jug of water from the cooking shop in Yanille if they do not have one to avoid a trip to Al Kharid.

steps.text: Talk to Brother Omad at the Monastery south of Ardougne.
chat: 1. Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?

steps.text: Go west of the monastery, slightly south-west of the Clock Tower, to a perfect stone circle, enter it and go down the ladder in the middle.
Follow the first path south and pick up the Child's blanket.
Return to Brother Omad and talk to him twice.
Go north and talk to Brother Cedric, who is directly south of the Ardougne Zoo, near the well.
Talk to him again to give him a jug of water.
Speak to him again and give him the logs or plank.
